title: Philips Google TV TA7 (TPV, PH3M_LT_T32 / device PH3M_AL_T32, MediaTek), Brazil
header:
Philips Google TV TA7 (TPV, PH3M_LT_T32 / device PH3M_AL_T32, MediaTek), Brazil
Google TV 14 (API 34), build UTT1.250308.001. About 1.9 GB RAM, armeabi-v7a, UI 1920x1080 on a 4K panel.
Fingerprint: Philips/PH3M_LT_T32/PH3M_AL_T32:14/UTT1.250308.001/101000072000:user/release-keys
Vendor packages: TP Vision org.droidtv.* on a MediaTek base (com.mediatek.*, mediatek.factorymenu.ui).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-google-tv-ta7/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-google-tv-ta7/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Launcher: TV_HOST=<tv ip> STOCK_LAUNCHER=com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1 launcher/build-and-install.sh
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Applied in batches on 2026-10-20 with a screenshot after each, then the custom launcher installed;
Home, HDMI 1 and Live TV, YouTube playback, HBO Max, Settings and every remote button were checked,
and everything survived a reboot. Not yet lived with for days.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. Home claimants: launcherx (priority 2),
setupwraith RecoveryActivity (1), com.android.tv.settings FallbackHome (-1000). While launcherx is
enabled, set-home-activity to another launcher does not stick.
Live TV app and HDMI player: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (TurnkeyUiMainActivity); the launcher's
default live_tv_package already matches. HDMI 1-4 are listed by com.mediatek.tvinput.

Quirks on this firmware, all checked on the TV:
- Port 5555 was already open and the PC already authorised; ro.adb.secure=1.
- `screencap -p` prints "Init wrapper sys mutex successful. Pid:..." before the PNG on stdout:
strip everything before the \x89PNG signature.
- The remote's Settings (gear) button is scancode 357 (KEY_OPTION) -> KEYCODE_SETTINGS (176), a
global key routed to com.mediatek.tv.service's HotKey GlobalKeyReceiver, which forwarded it to the
stock dashboard. With launcherx disabled it does nothing until HomeKeyService is on
(HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1, no config needed for KEYCODE_SETTINGS). Input and app buttons keep working.
- KEYCODE_GUIDE and KEYCODE_NOTIFICATION are global keys of launcherx; this remote does not send them.
- setupwraith owned one old saved network (not the one in use), and only that entry was deleted.

Kept on purpose: org.droidtv (TPVTvService, sees every key press), org.droidtv.icp (persistent
sign-on service, purpose unclear), org.droidtv.ambisvc (Ambilight/Lounge), org.droidtv.eum (user
manual; hidden in the launcher instead), com.mediatek.tv.service (hot keys, Netflix key, TV agent),
com.mediatek.tvinput, com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter, com.mediatek.wwtv.setupwizard (channel scan),
com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer (USB media), com.mediatek.autopair (remote pairing), com.mediatek.tv.factory
and mediatek.factorymenu.ui (factory menus), com.mediatek.android.leanbacklauncher.partnercustomizer
(crash-loops tv.service on another MediaTek set), com.android.tv.ota and com.easy.oad (firmware
updates), com.google.android.katniss (Assistant), Play Store, Play Services, both keyboards.
Disabled by the owner before this list and therefore not in it: cm.aptoide.pt, com.vscine.tv,
com.viki.android, fusion.android.tv.demo, com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx (ambient mode),
com.android.adservices.api, com.android.ondevicepersonalization.services,
com.android.federatedcompute.services, com.android.tv.feedbackconsent, com.google.android.feedback
and the two Health Connect packages.

apps.note: TP Vision "DAC" analytics: CollectionService, boot receiver, ~55 MB resident
TP Vision metrics GatheringService, shares candeebug's cache provider
Play auto-install of TPV partner apps
European satellite operator apps (Canal Digitaal, HD+, Skylink...), unused in Brazil
no calendar app on a TV

sections.title: Batch 5
sections.note: stock home. Disable only after the new launcher is installed (build-and-install.sh with STOCK_LAUNCHER does this). setupwraith goes first: its RecoveryActivity (HOME priority 1) otherwise takes Home. Check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first; on this TV it owned only an old, unused network.
